key_insight: Syn4D provides a high-quality multiview synthetic 4D dataset that supplies dense, complete, and accurate geometric and tracking annotations (camera motion, depth, dense tracking, and parametric human pose) for dynamic scenes, enabling more reliable training and evaluation of monocular video 3D reconstruction and tracking methods.
problem_solved: Addresses the scarcity of datasets with dense, complete, and accurate geometric and temporal annotations for dynamic scene reconstruction and tracking from monocular video.
method: Generate multiview synthetic dynamic scenes and render synchronized camera streams with ground-truth camera poses.
Produce dense per-frame ground-truth labels: depth maps, dense tracking (correspondences), and parametric human pose annotations.
Package diverse scenarios and metadata to support benchmarking and training of 4D reconstruction and tracking algorithms.
impact: Provides a reproducible, richly annotated benchmark that reduces reliance on sparse or noisy real-world labels, accelerating development and fair evaluation of algorithms for dense 3D reconstruction, tracking, and dynamic scene understanding.
visual_elements: Dataset overview panel: grid of rendered multiview frames showing synchronized views of a dynamic scene.
Annotation overlay examples: same frame with depth heatmap, dense tracking flow vectors, and parametric human pose skeleton.
Camera rig / pipeline diagram: showing multiview render → ground-truth generation → annotation outputs.
Benchmark/usage infographic: icons for tasks supported (depth, tracking, pose) and recommended evaluation flow.
paper_authors: Zeren Jiang, Yushi Lan, Yihang Luo, Yufan Deng, Zihang Lai
